narrator_hint: seventh-storyteller / ending routes: several characters; work out the speaker from context

rows.en:
So, it's finally my turn...
Nice to meet you all.
My name is Shoji Arai.
I'm a second-year.{p}This is rather sudden, but...
Do you all believe in past lives?{p}Do you think reincarnation exists?
I think it exists
I don't think it exists
There's no way to know that

Rebirth... It's also called the transmigration of souls.
Remembering who and where you were in a former life, or knowing in detail the past of a stranger you couldn't possibly know about...
Strange phenomena like that happen all over the world.
They aren't things that only happen in movies and TV dramas.
...The reason I say so is that I myself carry memories of my own past life.{p}You find that hard to believe?
{a}...
I can believe it
I can't believe it

I see.
So you're telling me you can believe it.
Well now, that makes me happy.
You're the first person who's ever said that to me, {a}.
When I bring this up out of the blue, most people get a suspicious look in their eyes and drift away from me...
Um... {a}.
Would you shake my hand?
I'm deeply moved right now.{p}Moved by you, {a}, for believing my story when we've only just met...
I don't mind shaking hands
I don't want to shake hands

...Ah, I will never forget the warmth of this hand.
Anyway, please listen to my story.
I still have memories of my past life.
...Yes, I remember them clearly.
Everything, from the time I first became aware of the world in my past life, through my death, until I was born anew...
Did you know?{p}

In that cradle-like space, I thought about one thing the whole time.
About the life I'd led until then...
In other words... about my life in my past life.
In my past life I didn't live in medieval Europe, or ancient Egypt, or some South Pacific paradise.
It was just a few decades ago...{p}

In my past life, I was an ordinary boy who lived in this town.
My family back then was my father, my mother, and one brother two years older than me...
My parents were busy and often away from home, so I was practically raised by that brother.
Unlike me, clumsy and painfully shy, my brother was bright and cheerful, the kind of person who'd end up at the center of every circle before you knew it.{p}
My brother's name was Soichiro.{p}

............Oh?
{a}...
Just now, the moment you heard my brother's name, you were a little startled, weren't you?
I was startled
No, I wasn't

...Ah, I thought so.
Is there something about my brother's name?{p}
I just thought it was a wonderful name...
I just thought it sounded nostalgic...
I just thought it was a frightening name...

Oh, so it feels nostalgic to you.
Isn't that surely because you had a deep connection with that name in your past life, {a}?
Perhaps you knew someone by that name...
Or perhaps you were called that yourself...
Of course, it's not an unusual name, so it wouldn't be the least bit strange if you knew someone with the same name in this life, either...{p}
...Let's get back to the story.{p}

My brother doted on me so much.
I always used to tag along after him.
Someone once told me I looked like a chick fresh out of the egg, trailing after the mother bird.
Looking back now, maybe it was said half in jest, but to me back then, it was nothing but the highest praise.
Just being by my brother's side made me happy.{p}

Of course...
I knew well enough that such happiness wouldn't last forever.
When you grow up, each of you has your own world, and it keeps growing wider.
Once that happens, you can't be together around the clock forever, the way you were as children...
Even so, those happy times should have lasted a while longer.
If only that incident had never happened...{p}

My brother was a second-year in high school.
I was a third-year in middle school.
Going home with my brother after school was my daily routine.
When my brother spotted me from his classroom window, he would wave to me with big sweeps of his arm.
That was the signal for 'Be right there.'
Once I saw it, I'd wave back just as big...
That was the signal for 'Got it.'{p}

That day, too, I was standing near the gate of the high school my brother went to.
I was watching the school building, waiting impatiently for my brother to show his face.
After a while, he appeared at the usual window.
Yes...
Even now, the image of my brother at that moment is burned vividly into the backs of my eyelids.{p}

A classroom on the top floor of the wooden school building...
At the third window from the right, my brother is waving with big sweeps of his arm.{p}

What a bright, refreshing smile it is...
The finest smile, meant for me alone.{p}

...The terrible tragedy happened right after that.
The very instant I tried to signal back...☆{p}
My brother's body pitched forward and was dashed straight into the ground!{p}

You see, to me as a middle schooler, the high school was a sacred place I could never set foot in.
I'd always believed I would only be allowed inside once I became a high school student myself.
Even after a wall of people surrounded my brother's body and I couldn't see it anymore, I couldn't take a single step from the school gate.
I was picturing the bright red blood gushing out of my brother's body...
The ground that soaked up my brother's blood still bears the mark today.{p}

Below the old school building... From here, it's hidden right behind the shrubbery.
I'm told it was a flowerbed, of sorts...
After my brother died, it became a bare patch of ground where neither flowers nor grass would grow.
Only the part that soaked up the blood has darkened like a stain, so you can easily make it out even from far away.
From my classroom, it's in plain view, though...{p}

...Ah, I forgot to mention.
My brother was a student at this school.
Of course, my past self intended to go on to this school too.
...But after my brother died, my health declined sharply...
I died before I could even graduate from middle school.
"They were such close brothers... his big brother must have called for him..."
People whispered that, though no one could say who started it.
In this life, the reason I came to this school was that I was curious about the school my brother once went to.
It's the place of memories that stays most deeply in my heart...
...Maybe I was searching for some trace of my brother.
You see, there was a place I'd made up my mind to visit as soon as I entered this school.
And that place was...{p}Where do you think it is?
The classroom where your brother was
The flowerbed that soaked up your brother's blood
The gate where you waited for your brother

...Yes.
As it happens, you're right.
It's the place where my brother met his final moment, the one I couldn't see that day...
I had wanted to visit the classroom where he'd been, too, but the old school building was off-limits.
I didn't think my brother would be pleased if I went so far as to break the rules...
So I headed to the flowerbed, thinking I could at least offer some flowers.{p}

Something is falling!
...That's what I felt.{p}

What met my eyes as I snapped them open was my brother, flung out into the air...
Without thinking, I spread my arms wide.
I was trying to catch my brother's body.
But his body vanished without ever touching my hands.
As if it had melted into the air.{p}

Wanting to let my brother rest in peace, I offered flowers and water almost every day and prayed with all my heart.
But it didn't seem to do any good at all.
My brother's ghost kept appearing almost every day.
Maybe there was some other cause behind this.
Was my brother trying to tell me something...?
That thought welled up in my mind.
And then, one day...!
I uncovered a crucial fact.{p}

At the instant my brother was flung into the air, two arms were reaching out of the classroom window...
The verdict on my brother's death, written off back then as an unfortunate accident, was in fact wrong.
Someone pushed my brother...
They were slender, white arms, so the one who pushed him was most likely a woman.{p}

...By the way, {a}?
You have a strange mark on your left hand, don't you?{p}

Three in a row... are those moles?
Yes, I noticed them when we shook hands earlier...
Did you know?
Normally, people shake hands with the right hand.
They say a left-handed handshake is the handshake for a farewell...
Well, that doesn't really have much to do with anything, but...
No... the truth is...{p}

The figure I saw also had three moles in a row on the left hand, just like you.
I could only see the hands, but I remember them clearly.{p}

{a}...
This is by no means a coincidence.
It's all a kind of karmic bond carried over from a past life.
I can see clearly who you were in your past life.
Shall I tell you?
Then I'm sure you'll remember too...
Please listen as well, everyone.{p}

In your past life, {a}, you were a girl named Kyoko Ichinose.
She was a childhood friend of us brothers, and ever since she was little, she'd adored my brother.
"I'm going to be Big Brother Soichiro's bride."
...That was what she always used to say.
She grew more beautiful day by day.
All just to become my brother's bride...{p}

...I suppose it was around the time she started middle school that her attitude became blatant...
Until then, the three of us did everything together, but she began openly ignoring me, and only me.
Was she trying to keep my brother all to herself?
But...
As I think I mentioned earlier, my brother loved me and doted on me more than anyone...
There was no way he'd fall for a girl who treated me so coldly.
In the end, her love went unrequited.
I think she pushed my brother to get back at him for that...
Yes, she was the one who killed my brother.{p}

...Oh?
What's the matter, {a}?
You're trembling so much...
And you look rather pale...{p}Was my story really that frightening?
It was scary
I'm not scared at all
I'm scared of you, Arai

But if I stay trapped in hatred forever, my brother will grieve.
He was a truly kind person...
If I were to kill you, it would only make him even sadder.
I could never do anything that cruel, you see.{p}

...That said, you mustn't let your guard down.
Listen to me.
You've been reborn in order to atone in this life for the sin you committed in your past one.
Let me see...
From now on, {a}, I'd like you to take my brother's place.
In place of my brother, the one you killed...{p}

...Still, it's a hot room, isn't it?
I'm getting rather thirsty.{p}At times like this, my brother would always go and buy me a cold juice...
Go buy some juice
Stay put and do nothing
Get angry

My, that's awfully good of you.
It's almost as if I'd been dropping hints....
Well, I suppose this much is only natural.
After all, you killed my brother, who meant more to me than my own life....
The sins of a past life must be atoned for in this one........
They say that otherwise you'll meet an even more wretched fate in the next.
...Well then, everyone.
Once {a} comes back with the juice, we'll hear the next person's story.
Oh, and {a}.
Make sure you buy some for everyone else too, please.
My brother was a wonderful person who never forgot that kind of consideration.
Hurry back, {a}.
The next person is waiting....{p}

...I see.
It's sad, but it can't be helped.
People find it hard to believe in things they've never seen with their own eyes....
But please, I'm begging you!
Just for today....
No, just for right now is enough.
Please believe that reincarnation exists.
All right?{p}

But I'm not going to give up over something like that.
Once you hear my story, {a}, I'm sure you'll believe me.
Just thinking about it gets me excited.{p}Now, first, let's shake hands.
To celebrate our meeting, don't you think?

"Don't say that....
I want to shake hands with you right now, {a}!"
With that, Arai took my hand and squeezed it tight.
"A-Arai...?"{p}

No.
It's no use hiding it.
I was watching you very closely, after all....
The moment you heard my brother's name, {a}, your eyebrow twitched.
Please answer honestly.
What is it about my brother's name?{p}

Thank you very much.
Well, of course I can't help but feel pleased when someone praises my brother's name.
But, {a}....
Do you have some fond memory attached to this name?
Perhaps you knew someone wonderful by this name....
Perhaps you once looked up to someone with this name....
It seems nothing comes to mind....
Perhaps it's a memory from a past life.{p}
...Let's get back to the story.{p}

Frightening...?
You really are a rude person, aren't you?
Please don't talk about someone's brother's name as if it were a curse.
Honestly, how rude can you be.{p}
...Now listen, I'm getting back to the story.{p}

In search of the truth, I sneaked into the old school building, which is off-limits.
It was even eerier than I'd imagined, a place where chilly air hung about.
The image I had once longed for, of a warm wooden school building, was completely gone.
I climbed the stairs, careful not to miss a step, though they looked ready to give way at any moment....
A few meters down the creaking hallway, there was my brother's classroom.{p}

Standing by the window, in the light of the setting sun, was a tall man.
A familiar back....
The back of my brother, who always walked a little ahead of me.
There's no way I could ever mistake my own brother.
A ghost...?
An afterimage...?
An illusion...?
No, it was nothing as insubstantial as a heat haze.
Because on the classroom floor, my brother's shadow stretched out long and sharp in the evening sun.
Just as I had been reborn as Shoji Arai, my brother had been reincarnated too....
That's what I thought.
And so... I worked up my courage and called out to him.{p}

Just as I used to, I called him "Brother"....
But my brother, standing at the window, didn't turn around.
...Was my voice too quiet?
So I tried once more.
This time I went a little closer and called to him in a clear voice.
Still, my brother didn't react.
Even when I shook him, even when I tapped him lightly, he showed no reaction at all.
As if I didn't even exist in his eyes....{p}

My brother seemed to have spotted someone outside the window; he slowly raised his right hand and began to wave it in big sweeps.
It was the 'Be right there' signal.
But I wasn't the one he was sending it to.
His eyes stayed fixed on something outside the window....{p}

The moment I saw that smile...
A certain feeling welled up inside me.
Jealousy... is that what you'd call it?
Something that should have been for me alone was being given to someone else....
Not only that, my brother didn't even notice me, right there beside him.{p}
In a flash of rage, I reached out for my brother's back and....{p}

...Yes.
He really did vanish.
He's going to hit the ground...☆
The instant I thought that, his body wavered with a whoosh and vanished, as if melting into the air.
For a while, I stood there in a daze, staring at the flowerbed I could see below the window.
Then, when I suddenly looked up, my eyes met those of a boy standing at the school gate.
In that instant...!
A certain memory came back to me.
That day my brother died....
There had been a figure that only I had seen, as I stood at the school gate, unable to take a single step....
The moment our eyes met, that person's face twisted in shock and terror....
That face was....{p}

None other than mine!
It was the face of Shoji Arai☆
...How terrible!
Out of jealousy toward my past self, I had killed my beloved brother.
The moment my brother died was the moment when the time of my past self and the time of my present self crossed.{p}

...Ah.
I can still feel it in my hands, the sensation of pushing my brother's back.
The warmth of his skin, its firmness, so clearly....
Ironic as fate may be, I must go on living, carrying the guilt of having killed my brother.
Praying that I'll meet him again someday....
Because I believe that will be the time to atone for my sin.
...That's all there is to my story.
Somehow it ended up feeling like you all heard my confession.
I hope all of you take my story as a lesson and live carefully.
The snares of fate are laid in the most unexpected places.
Losing someone you love is truly painful, you know....{p}Well then, shall we move on to the next person...?{p}

Yes, that's right.
You guessed it.
Just as my former self had done, I stood at the school gate and stared at the old school building.
I felt that if I did, I might be able to see my brother again....
Any moment now, surely, at that window....
With that thought, I kept standing at the school gate nearly every day.{p}

One month passed....
Two months passed....
Three months, four months, five months; only the days and months went by.
Still, there was no sign of my brother appearing.
And at last, a whole year had gone by.
Even I was starting to think about giving up.
But then...☆{p}

...Ah.
I still can't forget that day.
It was dusk, the same as always....
What I saw as I stood at the school gate was the familiar window of the familiar school building....
...And a single student who appeared at the window.
Someone who, like my brother, looked good in a white shirt and a smile.
I only saw him for an instant, but for me that alone was enough.
Unfortunately, he didn't seem to notice me, but I didn't mind in the least.
Because in that single instant, I knew that he was my brother reborn.{p}

Only....
This school has a huge number of students, you know.
Because of that, I had a hard time finding that student.
...Yes.
I had only just tracked down his class and name.
But this can only be called fate.
To think we'd meet again so soon...☆
The student who appeared at the window of the old school building that day....
That was....{p}{a}!{p}
It's you☆
That's ridiculous!
Actually, I thought so too

What are you saying!
The three moles lined up on your left hand are all the proof I need....
I saw them clearly when we shook hands just now.
There's no mistake!
You, {a}, are the reincarnation of my dear, dear brother.{p}

...Ah, Brother.
You still look like you don't quite understand.
That's only natural.
The shock of hitting your head so hard must have kept your past-life memories from coming back.
It's all right, Brother.
I'm sure you'll remember before long.
How much I adored you....
How lovingly you doted on me....
I'll tell you all about our bond, which no outsider could ever come between, from the bottom of my heart.
I'll be by your side, always....
...Yes, until you remember everything, I'll keep calling you {a}, just as before.
Otherwise everyone else would get confused.
Don't worry.
You'll remember your past life in no time.{p}

I'll make you remember, whatever it takes....
Come to think of it....
They say that when someone has lost their memory from a shock, giving them the same shock again brings it back....
...I wonder if that's true.
My brother died falling from the third floor of the old school building, so if we're going to give you the same shock, {a}, you'll just have to fall from there too.
Of course, there's the risk that you'll lose your life....{p}

...{a}?
Please don't look so frightened.
I'm not going to push you out a window here and now.
If we're recreating the conditions of my brother's death, it has to be from the old school building, after all.
And there's no sunset to be seen today....
...Ah.
But the old school building is going to be torn down over summer vacation, isn't it?
I hope we get to see a beautiful sunset before then....
When that time comes........{p}

{a}, please prepare yourself.
I'll be looking forward to that moment.
You wouldn't coldly turn down something your dear little brother is looking forward to, would you...?
I really am looking forward to it.{p}Well then, shall we move on to the next person's story?
{a}...?
Hurry up and pick the next one, please....{p}

"Actually....
I'd been thinking that might be the case too...."{p}

In my past life, Arai and I were brothers....
This warm feeling welling up in my chest....
This has to be what true brotherly love is!
Ah....
What a wonderful day today is....
I was trembling with emotion.
...And just then.{p}

"Wait a minute!"
Suddenly, one of the members cried out.
"Hold on.
That makes it sound like {a} was Arai's older brother!"
"Huh? That's not it?"
"Wrong, totally wrong.
Because the one who was Arai's brother in a past life is me!"{p}

...Whaaat★
Arai's older brother was this girl...★
"As I listened to the story, I remembered it clearly.
My name in my past life was Soichiro....
My family back then was my father, my mother, and one little brother, two years younger....
My little brother's name was..."{p}

"That's enough!"
The one who cut her off was none other than Arai himself.
"That's enough....
Now I know for certain that you are my brother.
The three moles lined up on your left hand are all the proof I need....
There's no mistake!
You are the reincarnation of my dear, dear brother.
...Ah, Brother."
"My little brother!"{p}

The two of them clasped each other's hands, shedding tears of emotion....
They truly seemed like brothers who were very close.
...Ah.
I feel as though I've seen a scene like this before.
Long, long ago....
...I see.
I must be the reincarnation of someone who lived in that era too.
Yes, that must be it.
Brothers from a past life, in a moving reunion....
This is going to make a fantastic article.
I'll base it on Arai's story....
That's it, I'll run an interview with the two of them too.
As I was lost in these dreamy thoughts....{p}

"So {a} was a complete stranger after all."
Arai, who until then had been weeping with joy over the reunion, suddenly murmured this in a voice without feeling.
"That's right.
He was jealous of what we had in our past life, so he told that lie."
The eyes of the two of them, staring at me, held a cold light somehow.
It was a far cry from the Arai who, just moments ago, had believed I was his brother....{p}

"What a terrible person you are.
Deceiving me like that...."
"I get it!
You were planning to steal my little brother away from me, weren't you?
You even lied that you were his brother in a past life...."
"Trying to come between the two of us is absolutely unforgivable."
The two of them rose from their chairs and slowly walked toward me.
Their eyes burning with the flames of hatred....
If this keeps up, I'm in danger!
I knew it, but caught between the two of them, I couldn't run even if I tried....
And at last, I was cornered against the window.
The two of them closed in, their mouths twisted eerily.
And then...,{p}

My body crashed through the window glass and was flung far out into the air.
...Ah.
Hasn't something like this happened before...?
Long, long ago....
...That's it!
I really was the reincarnation of Arai's older brother after all.
There's no doubt about it.
I know this momentary feeling of floating.
Back then, too, someone pushed me.
Who was it...?
Maybe that person is pretending to be me and deceiving Arai.
That's what I was thinking as I stared at the ground rushing up before my eyes.
And we'd finally met again....
We were such close brothers, and yet my little brother didn't recognize me....{p}
I had moles on my left hand too....{p}

A sharp impact ran through me, and my consciousness rapidly slipped away.
In my fading mind, the last thing I heard was the shrill laughter of my beloved little brother and the one he believed to be his brother.........{p}

You were scared?
I wonder if that's because you feel at least a little guilty....
But that little bit of fear won't erase my hatred.
It may have been in a past life, but you killed my brother.{p}
Not scared...?{p}

Just what I'd expect from the one who killed my brother.
You have no sense of guilt at all, I suppose.
That makes me feel much better.
Because now I can take my revenge without holding back....
You killed my brother, who meant more to me than my own life....
The sins of a past life must be atoned for in this one........
An eye for an eye....
I'll have you pay a life for a life.
A devoted younger brother overcomes countless hardships and is reborn to avenge his brother.
Isn't that a beautiful brotherly love...?{p}

Oh?
{a}, you're trembling.
Are you afraid of me?
...Now, that won't do.
Just a moment ago, you said,
"I'm not scared at all,"
didn't you?
You should carry yourself with more confidence.
After all, you're the hated enemy I've searched for all this time.
Do be as careful as you can.
On dark streets at night, especially....
...Your walk home today, for instance, seems very dangerous to me.
Well, you'd best get home before it gets too late.
With that, I'll end my story here.{p}

{a}....
Who's telling the next story...?{p}

Ah, this room really is hot.
The taste of the juice my brother used to buy me seems so nostalgic now.
It was truly delicious juice.
I suppose I'll never get to drink juice that delicious ever again.
Because my brother died on account of you, {a}....
Killing such a wonderful brother... you're a frightening person, {a}.
Truly....
It's hot, and I'm starting to feel sick.
Are you planning to kill us too, {a}?
Honestly, I can't see it any other way.{p}Ah, it's hot, so hot.
Go buy some juice
Get angry

"Quit acting so spoiled!
Is that any way to ask someone for a favor★
Just because you're my senior doesn't mean you can get away with anything.
If you talk like that, your dead brother will be heartbroken!"{p}

..................Huff, huff.
Rattling all that off in one go left me out of breath.
But if I didn't say that much, it didn't seem like he'd ever understand....
I can't just accept atoning for the sins of a past life I don't even remember.
Besides....
Even if I do have to atone for something, I think it should be in some other way.
It certainly isn't by doing whatever Arai tells me to.
...........................................................................................................But still.{p}

It's a little creepy how Arai has gone completely silent....
Maybe my words came as a shock to him.
"Arai...?"
"...Th-"
"Th...?"
"Those words just now....
Please, {a}!
Scold me one more time!"
......Huh?
What on earth is going on?{p}

"Please.
No one has scolded me since my brother died.
Please scold me again."
"W-Well, even if you say so..."
"Oh, then I'll go buy something.
Aren't you thirsty?
Just wait a moment, please.
I'll get you some cold juice or..."{p}

With that, Arai dashed out of the room.
What a hard guy to figure out.
Was he happy that I scolded him...?
Oh well.{p}"Well then, once Arai is back, I'd like to move on to the next story.
Next is..........."{p}
